The company

GWD Global Private Limited: how it started, who leads it, and how far it reaches.

  • Journey

It started as a student idea

In March 2024, a handful of students saw a gap: skilled young people couldn't get real client work, and real clients couldn't find affordable, capable teams. GWD put itself in the middle. The name never changed, because the mission never did.

  1. Mar 2024

    A student initiative begins

    A freelance collective connecting young talent with paid client work.

  2. Dec 2024

    Recognised in year one

    Top 500 Upcoming Startups of Asia and Top 25 of India, by E-Cell Bombay.

  3. Jun 2025

    Officially incorporated

    GWD Global Pvt. Ltd., registered with the MCA on 12 June. Office in Madhapur.

  4. 2025

    GWD Club launches at VJIT

    The biggest club inauguration in VJIT's 25-year history.

  5. 2026

    GWD Sports goes live

    Our first product line, and a company now working across 10 countries.

The club

Why GWD Club exists, how it's structured, and how it runs day to day.

  • Why it exists
  • Structure
  • How it runs
  • Departments

We didn't build another college club

Most students graduate without ever working on something real. That's the exact gap GWD was started to close in 2024, and the club brings it to every student on campus.

GWD Club runs like a company because a real company stands behind it: departments, deadlines, live work, and accountability.

Launched at VJIT in 2025 as the biggest club inauguration in the college's 25-year history, with Meraj Faheem (CEO, Telangana Innovation Cell) and Sadiya Sabira (CEO, Code for India) as chief guests.

Your growth path in the club

From your first workshop to a real internship. Workshops and project training are free for every member. Internships open up as you show interest and talent.

  1. Step 1, free

    Workshops

    Hands-on sessions across different technologies, run for members.

  2. Step 2, free

    Real projects

    Training on live projects GWD Global Private Limited delivers for clients.

  3. Step 3

    Internships

    Placements through GWD's channels and partner network.

  4. Step 4

    Intern at GWD

    An internship with GWD itself, for members with genuine interest and real talent.

Show up, do the work, and the path opens up. Your lead will tell you where to start.

Exposure you won't get in a classroom

We'll visit industries and events together. Every visit is something new, and every one adds real experience for members and leads.

  • Industry visitsInside companies, seeing how real work gets done.
  • Events and ecosystem daysStartup events, incubators and expos, where the industry meets.
  • For members and leads alikeEveryone comes back with something they didn't know before.

Not just a campus club.
A community across Hyderabad.

We organise events at multiple colleges, so you get exposure on new campuses and build a network there. Target: 10+ colleges by next year.

  1. 1
    Partner with a college clubWe start with collaborations, not takeovers.
  2. 2
    Co-host events on their campusThey see how GWD Club runs, first-hand.
  3. 3
    Launch a GWD Club chapterSame departments, same standards, one connected network.

The long gameIndia's largest student-led ecosystem

Got a startup idea? We'll back it.

Any member or lead with an idea gets the support we wish we'd had when GWD was just a student idea in 2024.

  1. Step 1

    Refine

    We pressure-test the idea with you and sharpen it into something buildable.

  2. Step 2

    Mentor

    The founders who took GWD from a student idea to a registered company guide you through it.

  3. Step 3

    Network

    Introductions across our 650+ network, clients in 10 countries, and ecosystem partners.

  4. Step 4

    Invest

    For ideas that prove themselves, GWD can come in as an investor.

Talk to your department lead, or come to me directly. No idea is too early.
